# After Studio

> Branding and creative agency in Belgrade, Serbia (an evolution of Coba&associates).

After Studio helps brands find clarity after strategy, after design, and after launch. Based in Belgrade, working with clients across Serbia and the region.

## Services
- Brand & Communication Strategy — the plan for building culturally relevant, resilient brands
- Creative Direction
- Verbal Identity — naming brand voice and stories
- Naming
- Visual Identity
- Packaging Design
- Graphic Design
- Digital Design

## Selected clients
Victoria Group, Medigroup, Delta Holding, Doncafé, Hotel Zlatibor, Grand Kopaonik, Martini Films, and other brands across Serbia.
